steps.caption: Open Transactions and the Lumen Harbour Tech transaction.
Section 10, LOI and term sheet. LOI v1 is a draft, unsigned.
It is checked against the agreed terms: lease duration was agreed at 60 months but is not in the LOI.
Add a version: an updated LOI with the duration clause.
Save version. The same title makes it version 2 of the same document; v1 is kept.
LOI v2 is compared with v1 — clauses added, removed or changed — and with the agreed terms.
Move its status along: draft, submitted, client review, counterparty review, agreed, signed, executed.
A term sheet is added the same way — choose term sheet as the type.
The point tracker (section 5) holds the agreed values these documents are checked against.
